name: wos-task
description: Personal task keeper and agenda lifecycle for Workflow OS. Handles simple Codex-only to-do lists, meeting action capture for the current user, source pull from connectors, optional Jira board sync, and an optional static dashboard template.

interface.shortDescription: ⭐ v0.1.5 · Codex agenda plus optional Jira sync
interface.longDescription: Workflow OS Task manages personal task agendas, manual and meeting action capture for the current user, one-off ticket work, checkpoints, orchestration, completion, a separate optional user-configured Jira task-board sync, and an optional GitHub Pages-ready dashboard template.
defaultPrompt: Capture my tasks into a Workflow OS agenda table.
